Title: Verify transition from Disconnected to Connected on CP 9V
Preconditions: EVCC powered on in Disconnected state; CP at 12V (State A)
Test_Steps: 1. Set EVSE CP voltage to 9V (State B). 2. Measure transition time on CAN signal EVCC_State.
Expected_Result: EVCC transitions to Connected within 200 ms (measured <= 200 ms).

Title: Verify connector lock engagement upon entering Connected state
Preconditions: EVCC in Connected state; connector unlocked
Test_Steps: 1. Monitor Lock_Actuator_Cmd and Lock_Status signals on CAN.
Expected_Result: Lock_Actuator_Cmd activates before CP State C request; Lock_Status confirms Locked.

Title: Verify fault handling on connector lock timeout (>1500 ms)
Preconditions: EVCC in Connected state; HIL simulating stuck lock actuator
Test_Steps: 1. Trigger lock command. 2. Hold Lock_Status = Unlocked for 1600 ms. 3. Check EVCC state and DTCs.
Expected_Result: EVCC aborts initialization at 1500 ms transitions to Error and logs DTC 0x910412.
Actual_Result: Transitioned to Error at 1510 ms; DTC 0x910412 active.

Title: Verify transition to Charging state on CP 6V and valid PWM
Preconditions: EVCC in Locked state; CP at 9V with 50% PWM duty cycle
Test_Steps: 1. Switch CP voltage to 6V (State C). 2. Monitor HV_Contactor_Cmd and EVCC_State.
Expected_Result: EVCC transitions to Charging and closes HV DC contactors.
Actual_Result: HV contactors closed; charging current ramping.

Title: Verify PWM current calculation at lower boundary (10% duty cycle)
Preconditions: EVCC in Charging state; BMS limit = 32A; Cable limit = 32A
Test_Steps: 1. Set CP PWM duty cycle to 10.0%. 2. Read negotiated EVCC_MaxCurrent on CAN.
Expected_Result: EVCC calculates I_max = 6.0 A (10 * 0.6A).

Title: Verify PWM current calculation at upper boundary (85% duty cycle)
Preconditions: EVCC in Charging state; BMS limit = 60A; Cable limit = 63A
Test_Steps: 1. Set CP PWM duty cycle to 85.0%. 2. Read negotiated EVCC_MaxCurrent on CAN.
Expected_Result: EVCC calculates I_max = 51.0 A (85 * 0.6A).

Title: Verify invalid low PWM fault handling (7.9% duty cycle)
Preconditions: EVCC in Charging state at 16A
Test_Steps: 1. Change CP PWM duty cycle from 26.6% to 7.9%. 2. Measure HV contactor opening time.
Expected_Result: HV contactors open within 100 ms and EVCC transitions to Error.
Actual_Result: Contactors opened in 68 ms; Error state active.

Title: Verify invalid high PWM fault handling (96.1% duty cycle)
Preconditions: EVCC in Charging state at 32A
Test_Steps: 1. Change CP PWM duty cycle from 53.3% to 96.1%. 2. Measure HV contactor opening time.
Expected_Result: HV contactors open within 100 ms and EVCC transitions to Error.
Actual_Result: Contactors opened in 142 ms (>100 ms limit).

Title: Verify current arbitration when BMS limit is lowest
Preconditions: EVSE PWM = 32A; Cable PP = 32A; BMS_MaxCurrent = 16A
Test_Steps: 1. Start charging session. 2. Measure actual OBC output current.
Expected_Result: OBC limits charging current to 16.0 A.

Title: Verify current arbitration when Cable PP rating is lowest
Preconditions: EVSE PWM = 32A; Cable PP = 13A (1500 Ohm); BMS_MaxCurrent = 32A
Test_Steps: 1. Start charging session. 2. Measure actual OBC output current.
Expected_Result: OBC limits charging current to 13.0 A.

Title: Verify no thermal derating just below threshold (74.9 C)
Preconditions: EVCC in Charging state at 32A; T_inlet = 70.0 C
Test_Steps: 1. Increase simulated NTC inlet temperature to 74.9 C. 2. Hold for 10s and check current.
Expected_Result: Charging current remains at 100% (32.0 A) with no derating.

Title: Verify 50% current derating at threshold (75.0 C)
Preconditions: EVCC in Charging state at 32A; T_inlet = 74.9 C
Test_Steps: 1. Increase simulated NTC inlet temperature to 75.0 C. 2. Measure OBC charging current.
Expected_Result: OBC derates charging current by 50% to 16.0 A.
Actual_Result: Current dropped to 16.0 A within 500 ms.

Title: Verify emergency shutdown on inlet over-temperature (85.1 C)
Preconditions: EVCC in Charging state (derated 16A); T_inlet = 84.0 C
Test_Steps: 1. Increase T_inlet to 85.1 C. 2. Verify HV contactors state and UDS DTC memory.
Expected_Result: Charging terminates immediately HV contactors open and DTC 0x910855 is stored.

Title: Verify connector remains locked while T_inlet > 60 C after fault
Preconditions: EVCC in Error state due to Over-Temp; T_inlet = 80.0 C
Test_Steps: 1. Send key fob unlock request while T_inlet = 80.0 C. 2. Cool T_inlet to 58.0 C and retry unlock.
Expected_Result: Connector stays locked at 80 C and unlocks only after cooling <= 60 C.
Actual_Result: Connector remained permanently locked even at 25 C until ECU reset.

Title: Verify CAN timeout tolerance at 490 ms (no false abort)
Preconditions: EVCC in Charging state; BMS_Status (0x185) cyclic 100 ms
Test_Steps: 1. Pause frame 0x185 transmission on HIL for 490 ms then resume. 2. Check EVCC state.
Expected_Result: Charging continues uninterrupted; no DTC logged.

Title: Verify emergency shutdown on BMS CAN timeout (>500 ms)
Preconditions: EVCC in Charging state; BMS_Status (0x185) cyclic 100 ms
Test_Steps: 1. Stop frame 0x185 transmission for 520 ms. 2. Verify EVCC state and DTC 0xC10087.
Expected_Result: Emergency shutdown triggered at 500 ms; DTC 0xC10087 logged.

Title: Verify UDS ReadDTCInformation (0x19 0x02) in Default Session
Preconditions: Active DTC 0xC10087 stored; ECU in Default Session (0x01)
Test_Steps: 1. Send UDS request 0x19 0x02 0x09 on 0x7E2. 2. Inspect positive response on 0x7EA.
Expected_Result: Positive response 0x59 0x02 containing DTC 0xC10087 returned.
Actual_Result: Positive response 0x59 0x02 received with expected DTC.

Title: Verify UDS ClearDTC (0x14) rejected during active Charging
Preconditions: EVCC in Charging state; stored historical DTC present
Test_Steps: 1. Send UDS request 0x14 0xFF 0xFF 0xFF. 2. Check response code.
Expected_Result: ECU rejects request with NRC 0x22 (ConditionsNotCorrect).

Title: Verify UDS ClearDTC (0x14) rejected when Vehicle Speed > 0 km/h
Preconditions: EVCC in Disconnected state; Vehicle_Speed = 15 km/h; stored DTC present
Test_Steps: 1. Send UDS request 0x14 0xFF 0xFF 0xFF. 2. Check response code.
Expected_Result: ECU rejects request with NRC 0x22 (ConditionsNotCorrect).
Actual_Result: ECU returned positive response 0x54 and cleared DTCs while moving!

Title: Verify safe unlock sequence triggered by user key fob during Charging
Preconditions: EVCC in Charging state at 32A
Test_Steps: 1. Trigger KeyFob_Unlock signal. 2. Measure current at exact moment of Lock_Actuator_Cmd.
Expected_Result: Charging pauses HV contactors open current drops < 1.0 A then connector unlocks.
Actual_Result: Current dropped to 0.2 A before lock disengaged.
